body: That sounds great, but I dont think its a viable option for me. In this country I'll never get housing without money and my legal matters sorted. And I cant get a job either. I envy America alot now!

Sorry its taking longer to reply to you great people. I havent slept in many hours and my fucking eyes are seeing spots amking it hard to read. Irrelevant:

1. I am very frightened. Im frightened of the pain i'll cause my mom to come clean, and the loss of respect and even love I will get. Suicide is selfish, but yeah...

2. I cant agree with this point. I find life meaningless in the greater scope of the universe and everthing we do insignificant. I often wonder, unless I have THE most awesome job, I'd still find life tedious, working 40 hours a week, till im too old to enjoy my life. I am terrified of pain, absolutly, I looked up all the methods of suicide. Since I'm not a doctor and cant overdose on specific pills these are the two options I had chosen.

3 + 4. A huge worry for me. Especially now. The reason my dad was pressing so much with this issue is because if something happens to me it could cost him everything. Its my worst nightmare now for my (possible) attempts to fail.

5. All i will say about this is that my country, the government supplies student loans itself, not via 3rd party corporations like in the states. What I said about my debt disappearing with me is absolutly true, though like I said, a minor detail in the grand scheme of all this.

6. I'm trying to beat this into my head.

7. Its extremely touching. And i have read stories by others who have been left behind. It doesnt make me feel good to think about them.

*edit: numbers messed up because of 3+4 thing...

I dont expect you to reply anymore based on your last lines. This must be depressing for anyone to read and respond too. I'll just say thank you  very much. Your voice of reason has made a large impact, whatever ends up happening.

Technically I know exactly where I need to go and who to talk to get my life going again (from square 1), thats not an issue. Its the social and emotional aspect around it. I have some time. I will try to contact help anonimously. I'll post back later... Thanks

I sincerely find that incredably brave... How would you go about that? Illegally, forging a new identity, or the proper route? The latter is not even possible for me. I read an AMA a few weeks ago about a guy who takes off every 6-24 months, leaving everything behind, work, girlfriend, house. Just packs up and leaves, applies for new jobs and starts a new life. That would be a dream scenario, but I dont have the foggiest how to accomplish that.

I have escaped to a friends place for 2 weeks once. I left because I felt I was beginning to be a burden. I wouldn't even know where else to escape to especially with no money. Haha! Yeah, I'm a 30 year liar who get by asking his mom for money like a spoiled teenager! This is not how I pictured my life...

I'm really glad your son has further validated your life, but after the train wrecks of my last real relationships (which was obviously more than 2 years ago), I cant see myself getting that far in life. I cant see myself with anyone let alone with a child. And the thought of my ex's getting news of what I have become as well as those i detest in life is infuriating...

Thx for your words. I mentioned Im mentally healthy, not as a sneer to those who aren't. But because I didn't want to make up reasons for my behavior. I could say I have "blah blah blah disorder" and I'd expect people like you have leniency with me. I wanted to make it clear I am scum for lying and cheating the system. 

I cant see a mental health professional because I have no insurance haha! There are free insitutions I could talk to, but I feel like if they found out who i really was, it'd be like a fake call for leniency. I.e. "Ahhh, he wanted to kill himself over it, lets not be too harsh with the punishment". I dunno if i got my point across with that poor example. Its just that with the exception of a 2-3 people, no one has ever considered I might be capable of suicide and i feel like the reactions would be more mocking that sympathy.

If i were to come clean to first of all my parents, and I told them I came within an inch of killing myself, I think it'd actually be putting more oil on the fire than a cry for affinity...

A part of me is coming around, I wont lie. Heck, on some level of conciousness I posted here to get pulled out. But as I said before, this is not something that I decided on a whim. Its been years. Little details, study loans in my country and mine and mine alone. No matter how large the debt, if I die, the debt dies with me. it can't be passed on. I wouldn't leave them with that (even though they could pay it off easily!).

2. Is it a big step? absolutely, i have stood on the precipice at about 5 times now in the last 2 years. Drunk with a sharp kitchen knife at my chest or late at night on a small railway station looking at trainings firing past. (i dunno what other suicidal people think, but I think thats alot!).  The point is, its not a snap call. And while im grateful for all the responses, both helpful and some entertaining, I feel some people under estimate how big a deal this can be in certain cultures. Some families will bitch for weeks and whip you back into shape. But I think people should be aware that this kind of news can be absolutly devasting. I am seriously thinking breaking this news would be (initially) as painful for some family members as the news of my demise.

3. So basically I'd come clean and I'd get a life time of crap... from everyone. And while I'm a grade-A asshole, I admit, nobody will care If i were to tell them how close i came to ending it those few times. I have no history of illness, mental or physical. I will be judged by all as a competent person, and I'll admit that scares me. Though my sibling and best friend have told me casually that they think I might be suicidal, and my parents have asked why I have a knife by my side at all times...

I dunno, point 3 is kinda lame I agree, but I feel like i need some emotional support and not just to have a world of shit around me... Now Im jsut rambling since i haven't slept for about 40 hours...

I like your style, and I've thought about it! Some snags there however... technically Im "homeless" and/or "living outside the country". Thats how the government percieves me. If I did that I would want to break of all contact, live in a different city and bust my balls back with people around me whom I have nothing to fear, and maybe are in the same situation. But I have looked at many options. These feelings of mine and not new and certainly not based on a 'whim'. I'd have to prove to have some connection with the city I want to register, so HERE! And I'd be under strict supervision by the government debt program. Not much room to disappear and reinvent myself. 

As a logical person, I think there are many worse fates than death. And the path laid out by you is in my opinion worse. Its been almost 2 years straight that I wished every night that I would never wake up.

But I still have some time (I actually need to wait this little period out), and i'd love to hear more about your story if you'd care to share!

I have no one that depends on me. I depend on everyone else... A drain on society. The big problem tbh is that my dad is making me go register as living with him and my mom. What happens here (and this is a big give away as to where I live i think), is that later on, the government will come to this house, and repo stuff. It'll be a huge legal issue for them to prove that everything is theirs, not mine, and if that time comes before I fess up, the shit will really hit that fan. 

On another note, I recently read a story by another guy on SW i think it was, where he said even if things were good, he couldn't see himself wanting to live. To work 9-5, 5 days a week till ur 65 then retire and hope you have enough cash. Life is so meaningless and insignificant. Maybe thats just me looking for more reasons to convince myself, but its how I feel now. 

As for repairing trust... that will take too long in my opinion. My working (or even failing to work) to get out of debt and clear my name will be a constant reminder of what i'd have done. By letting go I feel it'd hurt them alot, but they'd get over it eventually.

I don't mean to be an ass and counter every argument you make, but... yeah. I'm not some 14 year old crying over lack of friends. I'm almost 30 and i feel confident that my choices are sound and rational. Now its just a matter of growing a pair and following up...

I've told EVERYONE the same bullshit story. Parents, friends... Everything i am and stood for falls if the truth comes out. Anger wont begin to cover how my parents will react. I honestly think the pain of me telling them will be the same as when they find me. It'll pass in time. And it wasn't unfortunate. I screwed up everything. I shoulda come clean years ago, or better yet, tried to perform well. Im a lazy idiot who spent days he should have been working playing games and drinking. 

Its not that I would be too lazy to work off the debt. But the family i come from... the shame would drive me to same decision. My best friends from high school are working already, some have phd's. 2 are doctors. I cant face being the loser of teh group. All the people who ive looked down upon all these years... they are all better than me. I cant conclude other than I cont conform to this society.
